newsitem.title: LATVIA: DEPOSITORY TO EXTEND DELIVERY VERSUS PAYMENT.
newsitem.headline: DEPOSITORY TO EXTEND DELIVERY VERSUS PAYMENT.

text.p: The central depository said on Thursday it plans to extend the delivery versus payment system to financial companies which are not members of the bourse.
The depository plans to introduce direct cash payment or delivery versus payment for stocks not on the exchange and any deals by a finacial intermediary not a member of the bourse.
"We want to supplement the existing payment system," Martinsh Rikshis, president of the depository, told a news conference.
Changes in the depository's regulations will come into effect after finance ministry approval, Rikshis added.
Currently these transaction are taken care of by commercial banks.
